text: Welcome.
Take a breath, just as you are.
Let this be a moment just for you.
A moment to exhale the weight of expectations, the noise of the world.
A moment to come home to yourself.
You are safe here.
As you settle in, notice the soft rhythm of your breath.
The way it moves through you without effort. A quiet, steady current.
You've been breathing your whole life. But right now, in this moment, you get to feel it.
To witness it.
To rest inside it.
Inhale deeply, filling your body with warmth.
And exhale slowly, letting something inside you soften.
Breathe in.
And as you breathe out, imagine you are stepping into stillness.
A space where time slows. Where the mind quiets.
Where you remember the truth that has always been yours.
There is a place inside of you where abundance already exists.
A place untouched by worry, by doubt, by the illusion of not enough.
A place where everything flows, naturally and effortlessly.
And if you listen closely, you can feel it.
Like the hush of the ocean before the waves rise.
Like the quiet hum of the earth beneath your feet.
Abundance is not something you chase. It's something you tune into.
Something you relax into.
So imagine now, a golden warmth rising in your chest. Soft and steady.
This is the energy of receiving.
Let it expand with every inhale.
Let it settle with every exhale.
If any thoughts of doubt arise, old stories of struggle or scarcity, just notice them.
No need to hold on. No need to push them away.
Just let them drift, like leaves floating downstream.
With each breath you feel lighter, clearer, more open.
Like something is shifting, settling into place.
There is nothing to figure out, nothing to force. Just this feeling, this quiet knowing that everything you need is already moving toward you.
Now imagine you're standing beneath a warm golden light, flowing effortlessly around you.
This is the energy of abundance. It's always here, always moving, always available.
You don't have to reach for it. You don't have to earn it. Just let it be here with you.
Let it sink in.
Let these words settle gently, like waves washing onto shore.
Abundance is already flowing to me in ways seen and unseen.
I don't have to chase it. I just have to stay open.
I trust that life is always working in my favor.
Everything I need is finding its way to me.
Take a slow, easy breath in.
And exhale fully. No rush, no urgency.
Just this steady feeling of ease, of knowing, of being right where you're meant to be.
When you're ready, start to bring a little movement back into your body.
Wiggle your fingers, roll your shoulders.
Let yourself ease back in gently.
And whenever it feels right, open your eyes.
No need to hold on to anything.
Just carry this feeling with you.
